name: Haina
source:
The maid of the house. Humble, hardworking, somewhat clumsy and makes great tea, she is attentive to people’s feelings and a honest girl. Tends to have a low self-esteem, often lowering her head when talking to others. Her favorite pastime is cleaning the mansion.

[Edited and taken from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/12/04/midori-no-umi-review/]Warum's review[/url].]
